sources.title: SphereFace Models | yakhyo/face-recognition | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Purpose and Scope This document provides detailed technical documentation of the SphereFace model architectures available in this face recognition framework. SphereFace models are server-oriented neural networks designed for high-accuracy face recognition tasks where computational resources are less constrained compared to mobile deployments.

sources.title: SphereFace Model and A-Softmax Loss | wy1iu/sphereface | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Purpose and Scope This page covers the SphereFace neural network architectures (SphereFace-4, SphereFace-20, SphereFace-36, SphereFace-64), their structural design decisions relative to standard ResNets, the A-Softmax loss function and its angular margin formulation, and the modified gradient normalization used in the backward pass.
